title: Pakistan refiner Cnergyico expands US crude imports amid Hormuz disruption
desc: KARACHI: Pakistan’s largest refiner Cnergyico is buying more US crude as Islamabad seeks to diversify the country’s energy supplies after disruption caused by the Iran war exposed its dependence on Gulf routes. Pakistan also wants to increase imports from the US to help narrow its trade surplus and secure reductions in trade tariffs imposed by President Donald Trump.

desc: U.S. President Donald Trump stated on Monday that the primary objective of the United States has been and will remain preventing Iran from acquiring a nuclear weapon in any shape or form.

title: Trump Says Iran Cannot Have a Nuclear Weapon
desc: US President Donald Trump reiterated on Monday that Iran cannot have a nuclear weapon amid a lack ⁠of progress in diplomatic ⁠efforts to resolve the Middle East conflict. "The ⁠number one Goal is, and always will be, that Iran cannot have, in any way, shape, or form, ⁠a Nuclear ⁠Weapon," Trump said in a post on Truth Social. His comment came as the 60-day negotiating period to find a peace deal between the US and Iran was expiring, with no word of an extension and both sides seemingly as far apart as they were two months ago.

title: Clifford Chance advises EE Capital as Fenway Sports Group agrees strategic minority investment in Liverpool Football Club
desc: Global law firm Clifford Chance has advised EE Capital, the family office of Elaine and Eduardo Saverin and an investor in 1892 Holdings, on its investment in Liverpool F.C. 1892 Holdings is a consortium led and managed by Amit Bhatia, with investments from Amit Bhatia and the Mittal Family Trusts, K5 Sports (a K5 Global Fund), with Jeff Bezos as the lead investor in the K5 Sports fund and EE Capital.
